How much does a kitchen renovation cost on the North Shore? Costs vary widely by scope, access, materials and the provider you choose. A light refresh that keeps the layout is typically far lower than a full redesign with custom joinery, structural changes and premium benchtops. North Shore homes often sit at the higher end because of prestige finishes and tricky site access. Always ask for a written scope and an itemised quote before any work starts. What should be included in a kitchen renovation quote? A useful quote should define demolition, cabinetry, benchtops, splashback, appliances, plumbing, electrical, finishing, exclusions, timing and how variations are handled. Inclusions and exclusions are where quotes differ most, so compare them line by line rather than on headline price alone. Is it cheaper to refresh a kitchen than to fully renovate? Usually, yes. A makeover that reuses the existing carcasses and keeps plumbing and electrical in place, swapping door fronts, benchtop, splashback and hardware, typically costs much less than a full strip-out and redesign. The right choice depends on the condition of the existing kitchen and how much the layout is holding you back. Should I renovate the kitchen before selling? A focused kitchen update can help presentation, but the right scope depends on the property value, likely buyer expectations and your timing. Avoid overcapitalising. A measured refresh often presents better value than a full premium renovation done
